visualBrief.sceneDescriptionZh: 维多利亚时代工程控制室，墙上三个黄铜仪表，前两个显示通过，第三个红灯卡住
focalElementsEn: two green gauges with steam venting
one red stuck gauge with cracked glass
visualBrief.imagePromptEn: A Victorian-era engineering control room. Three massive brass monitoring gauges on the wall — the first two show green approved signals with steam venting. The third gauge is red, needle stuck, cracked glass. A steam pipe bursts beside it. On a workbench, scattered blueprints and a brass pocket watch frozen at 11:12 AM.
